description: This file defines classes related to PDF content stream operators in the PDFsharp library, including the OpCode class representing individual operators and the OpCodes static class containing all known PDF operators with their metadata.

classes.name: OpCode
classes.description: Represents a PDF content stream operator with metadata such as name, opcode, operands, description, and flags.

classes.name: OpCodes
classes.description: Static class that contains the collection of all PDF operators as OpCode instances and provides utility methods like OperatorFromName.

methods.name: OperatorFromName
methods.description: Retrieves an OpCode object corresponding to the given operator name.
